t: Complete spill response kit specifically designed for the safe and efficient clean-up of everyday spills, incorporating maintenance absorbent socks made with a spunbond outer layer to maximise tensile strength, liquid retention, and durability. Includes maintenance absorbent pads, perforated for controlled usage, and produced from high-loft meltblown polypropylene fibres, ensuring excellent absorbency performance and strength. A compact clip-top bag allows for easy storage, handling, and transport, while the durable clear bag features bold labelling for quick identification during emergencies. This single-use kit is intended for immediate deployment, providing a fast, effective solution when unexpected spills occur.
